summary: Travel advance settlement shows unexplained variance after multi-currency conversion
description:
Issue summary:
A traveler (E. Kaur) submitted an expense settlement for a €2,300 travel advance. The reimbursement processed shows a settled amount that differs by €17.40 after the payments system converted currencies and applied bank fees.

Impact:
- Employee has an outstanding balance that prevents closure of the travel advance.
- Finance cannot reconcile the ledger for Q1 until the variance is explained.

Environment:
- Expense platform: Redwood Expenses (prod)
- Payment rail: BankWire EU (partner bank)
- Region: eu-west

Initial evidence:
- Original advance issued: 2026-01-15, amount: EUR 2,300, PO/advance ID ADV-2026-8975
- Settlement submitted: 2026-02-20, itemized receipts in EUR and GBP (airport transfer paid in GBP).
- Payment recorded in ledger: EUR 2,282.60 (difference EUR 17.40).

Desired outcome:
- Identify source of EUR 17.40 variance (FX rounding, bank fee, reimbursement policy).
- Post corrective entry or issue supplemental payment to employee if required.

Notes on scope:
- This is internal support (no external customers). Ledger and AP integrity required for month-end close.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Locate advance ADV-2026-8975 in Redwood Expenses console
2) Open settlement submission dated 2026-02-20 and export receipts and line items
3) Review AP payment record and bank transaction for the corresponding payout date
4) Compare per-line conversions (GBP->EUR) and any applied fees recorded by the payment provider
5) Check GL posting for rounding or FX adjustment entries during settlement batch processing
logs: Expense export CSV (attached to ticket) shows net reimbursable EUR 2,300 before per-diem adjustments
AP payment trace ID: PW-32918-BNK shows outbound amount EUR 2,282.60 and bank reference 'BKFEE 1.75 GBP'
Bank payout CSV row: 2026-02-24, beneficiary E. Kaur, amount 2,282.60 EUR, fees 15.20 EUR (converted)
investigation_notes: 2026-03-01 10:12 - Finance ops: Confirmed settlement includes a GBP transaction (airport transfer) that was converted by the payment provider. Provider returns their own FX conversion and fee column.

2026-03-01 14:05 - Payments team: Provider CSV shows two separate entries for same payout: gross EUR 2,300, fees 15.20 EUR, net EUR 2,284.80. AP ledger shows EUR 2,282.60; discrepancy of EUR 2.20 identified between provider net and ledger net.

Hypothesis A: Double rounding when converting GBP receipt and then reconverting to EUR for ledger posting.
Hypothesis B: Manual adjustment applied by AP clerk to correct previous small rounding, not documented in settlement notes.
    Hypothesis C: Interbank fee of ~EUR 2.20 applied by correspondent bank and not reflected in provider CSV.
